status: Exploratory checkpoint requested after observing earlier pilot and collection progress; not a new preregistration.
selection: Exactly collection_order 1 through 400 of the original frozen sample, shared across models; all are original training puzzles.
regression: Pooled binomial GLM using the frozen full board-feature recipe plus Gemini and Claude indicators (GPT-OSS reference). Unpenalized; ordinary 95% intervals with standard errors clustered by puzzle_id. Require at least 50 successes and 50 failures per model, full rank, finite converged fit and no separation. No silent predictor deletion.
prediction: Separate XGBClassifier per LLM fitted on all 400 cases. Fixed parameters inherited from final XGBoost plan, without tuning or early stopping.
cv: Exploratory 5-fold out-of-fold evaluation within these 400 training puzzles. One shared fold assignment, stratified by pre-existing human rating bands, shuffled with seed 401. Fit 320, predict 80 per fold per model. Final 200 test puzzles excluded. Cache out-of-fold predictions and native full-400 models; reuse on rerun.
metric_note: LLM solution-move accuracy and XGBoost accuracy predicting LLM success are different quantities. CV is exploratory and does not replace final held-out evaluation.
